key: "Captain's Log"
en: "Captain's Log"
ja: 「船長日誌」

key: Should you read this?
en: Should you read this?
ja: これを読みますか?

key: Transit Log: Stock: 4,600 Poké Balls; 1,200 Potions; 1,200 Super Potions; 1,200 Hyper Potions; 1,200 Max Potions; 2,400 Full Heals; 800 Full Restores
en: Transit Log: Stock: 4,600 Poké Balls; 1,200 Potions; 1,200 Super Potions; 1,200 Hyper Potions; 1,200 Max Potions; 2,400 Full Heals; 800 Full Restores
ja: 輸送記録:在庫:モンスターボール4,600個、キズぐすり1,200個、いいキズぐすり1,200個、すごいキズぐすり1,200個、まんたんのくすり1,200個、なんでもなおし2,400個、かいふくのくすり800個

key: En route to Reborn City via the Orre Region, order of Silph Co.
en: En route to Reborn City via the Orre Region, order of Silph Co.
ja: オーレ地方経由、リボーンシティ行き。シルフカンパニーからの発注。

key: Transit: Empty Freight
en: Transit: Empty Freight
ja: 輸送:空の貨物

key: En route to the Orre Region via Reborn City
en: En route to the Orre Region via Reborn City
ja: リボーンシティ経由、オーレ地方行き

key: Transit Log: Stock: 4,600 Poké Balls; 4,600 Great Balls; 4,600 Ultra Balls; 800 Lure Balls; 800 Heavy Balls; 800 Timer Balls; 800 Dusk Balls
en: Transit Log: Stock: 4,600 Poké Balls; 4,600 Great Balls; 4,600 Ultra Balls; 800 Lure Balls; 800 Heavy Balls; 800 Timer Balls; 800 Dusk Balls
ja: 輸送記録:在庫:モンスターボール4,600個、スーパーボール4,600個、ハイパーボール4,600個、ルアーボール800個、ヘビーボール800個、タイマーボール800個、ダークボール800個

key: Continue reading?
en: Continue reading?
ja: 続けて読みますか?

key: Transit Log: Stock: 6,000 Oran Berries; 4,000 Pecha Berries; 4,000 Chesto Berries; 4,000 Pomeg Berries; 5,000 Lum Berries; 100 Jaboca Berries
en: Transit Log: Stock: 6,000 Oran Berries; 4,000 Pecha Berries; 4,000 Chesto Berries; 4,000 Pomeg Berries; 5,000 Lum Berries; 100 Jaboca Berries
ja: 輸送記録:在庫:オレンのみ6,000個、モモンのみ4,000個、カゴのみ4,000個、ザロクのみ4,000個、ラムのみ5,000個、ジャポのみ100個

key: Incident Record: A regular pitstop was made this afternoon at 3:15 PM in the Tourmaline Desert to service engine trouble.
en: Incident Record: A regular pitstop was made this afternoon at 3:15 PM in the Tourmaline Desert to service engine trouble.
ja: 事故記録:本日午後3時15分、トルマリン砂漠にて、エンジントラブル対応のため定期停車を実施。

key: After local wildlife endured a scuffle, the crew incidentally adopted one Pokémon Egg, now in cargo.
en: After local wildlife endured a scuffle, the crew incidentally adopted one Pokémon Egg, now in cargo.
ja: 現地の野生生物との小競り合いの末、乗組員が偶然ポケモンのタマゴを一つ引き取り、現在貨物内に保管している。

key: No issues expected with the Egg's acquisition.
en: No issues expected with the Egg's acquisition.
ja: タマゴの入手について、問題は生じないと見込まれる。

key: It will be relinquished to company or personnel at request.
en: It will be relinquished to company or personnel at request.
ja: 要請があれば、会社または担当者に引き渡す予定。

key: And a little bonus I picked up for my little girl back home in Orre.
en: And a little bonus I picked up for my little girl back home in Orre.
ja: それと、オーレの故郷にいる娘のために、ちょっとしたおまけを拾っておいた。

key: Incident Record: An emergency stop was made this Tuesday at 11:53 PM.
en: Incident Record: An emergency stop was made this Tuesday at 11:53 PM.
ja: 事故記録:今週火曜日、午後11時53分に緊急停車を実施。

key: An unidentified railway obstruction has brought the vehicle to a halt.
en: An unidentified railway obstruction has brought the vehicle to a halt.
ja: 正体不明の線路上の障害物により、車両が停止した。

key: Suspected fallen tree or other similar debris.
en: Suspected fallen tree or other similar debris.
ja: 倒木、または類似の障害物と思われる。

key: Though currently too dark to investigate, will do so in the morning.
en: Though currently too dark to investigate, will do so in the morning.
ja: 現在は暗すぎて調査できないため、朝になってから確認する予定。

key: Approx. projected delay: 8 hours.
en: Approx. projected delay: 8 hours.
ja: 予想遅延時間:約8時間。

key: Friday 9:12 AM: I've identified the aforementioned obstruction, though it baffles me.
en: Friday 9:12 AM: I've identified the aforementioned obstruction, though it baffles me.
ja: 金曜日 午前9時12分:先述の障害物を確認したが、困惑している。

key: Specifically, an entire tree has grown in the middle of the rails.
en: Specifically, an entire tree has grown in the middle of the rails.
ja: 具体的には、線路の真ん中に木が一本、まるごと生えているのだ。

key: I do not believe there is any such way that I can clear it alone.
en: I do not believe there is any such way that I can clear it alone.
ja: 一人でこれを取り除く方法は、どうしても見当たらない。

key: As such, I will be returning to Reborn City to request assistance.
en: As such, I will be returning to Reborn City to request assistance.
ja: そのため、支援を要請するため、リボーンシティへ戻ることにする。

key: Incident Record: Friday 1:37 PM
en: Incident Record: Friday 1:37 PM
ja: 事故記録:金曜日 午後1時37分

key: In what I can only assume is an elaborate prank, I have failed to return to Reborn City.
en: In what I can only assume is an elaborate prank, I have failed to return to Reborn City.
ja: 手の込んだいたずらだとしか思えないのだが、リボーンシティへ戻ることができなかった。

key: As I reversed the train down the same track which I had traveled just yesterday, I found a large portion of the rail to be missing entirely.
en: As I reversed the train down the same track which I had traveled just yesterday, I found a large portion of the rail to be missing entirely.
ja: 昨日通ったばかりの線路を逆走してみると、線路の大部分がすっかり失われていた。

key: The wood beams are scattered haplessly between the trees, and the metal has been contorted, and in some places, is absent entirely.
en: The wood beams are scattered haplessly between the trees, and the metal has been contorted, and in some places, is absent entirely.
ja: 木製の枕木は木々の間に無造作に散らばり、金属部分はゆがみ、場所によっては完全に消え失せている。

key: In light of this, I am unable to move the freight at all, and will be returning to Reborn City on foot.
en: In light of this, I am unable to move the freight at all, and will be returning to Reborn City on foot.
ja: このため、貨物を動かすことは一切できず、徒歩でリボーンシティへ戻ることにする。

key: It should not take more than a day to reach the city, and assuming available resources, repairing the rail could be done in as little as two weeks.
en: It should not take more than a day to reach the city, and assuming available resources, repairing the rail could be done in as little as two weeks.
ja: 街に到着するまで一日もかからないはずで、資材さえそろえば、線路の修理も最短二週間ほどで済むだろう。

key: Approx. projected delay: 18 days.
en: Approx. projected delay: 18 days.
ja: 予想遅延時間:約18日。

key: Sunday 8:25 PM:
en: Sunday 8:25 PM:
ja: 日曜日 午後8時25分:

key: In the continuing saga of happenstances causing me to question my mental health, I have been unable to follow the track to Reborn City.
en: In the continuing saga of happenstances causing me to question my mental health, I have been unable to follow the track to Reborn City.
ja: 精神の健全さを疑わずにはいられない出来事が続く中、リボーンシティへの線路をたどることができずにいる。

key: The scattered wood and disjointed metal I mentioned before was a dramatic understatement.
en: The scattered wood and disjointed metal I mentioned before was a dramatic understatement.
ja: 先に述べた散乱した木材とゆがんだ金属というのは、控えめな表現に過ぎなかった。

key: Entire segments of the track have been disapparated.
en: Entire segments of the track have been disapparated.
ja: 線路の区間がまるごと、こつ然と消え失せているのだ。

key: Between the increasingly befuddling thickness of forestry and the baffling apparent deconstruction of the rail, I am unable to return to Reborn.
en: Between the increasingly befuddling thickness of forestry and the baffling apparent deconstruction of the rail, I am unable to return to Reborn.
ja: ますます密度を増す不可解な森と、線路の謎めいた崩壊とに阻まれ、リボーンへ戻ることができずにいる。

key: In response to this distortion, I will follow the track on foot-- the only way in which it is (relatively) navigable, towards the Orre Region.
en: In response to this distortion, I will follow the track on foot-- the only way in which it is (relatively) navigable, towards the Orre Region.
ja: この異常事態を受けて、線路を徒歩でたどることにする――(比較的)進める唯一の道として、オーレ地方の方向へ。

key: Though it is a considerable distance to walk, I see no second option.
en: Though it is a considerable distance to walk, I see no second option.
ja: 歩くにはかなりの距離だが、他に選択肢は見当たらない。

key: Approx projected delay: 7 days.
en: Approx projected delay: 7 days.
ja: 予想遅延時間:約7日。

key: Monday 5:39 PM:
en: Monday 5:39 PM:
ja: 月曜日 午後5時39分:

key: It appears I was hasty in my evaluation of the forward-going rail as 'navigable'.
en: It appears I was hasty in my evaluation of the forward-going rail as 'navigable'.
ja: 前方の線路を「進める」と判断したのは、早計だったようだ。

key: Though I have ridden this way many times, I find the track going forward to be as distorted as it was going back.
en: Though I have ridden this way many times, I find the track going forward to be as distorted as it was going back.
ja: 何度もこの道を通ってきたはずなのに、前方の線路も、来た道と同じようにゆがんでいるのに気づいた。

key: These woods are mocking, with trees so in and out and roundabout such that one feels as if they've gone in circles forever.
en: These woods are mocking, with trees so in and out and roundabout such that one feels as if they've gone in circles forever.
ja: この森はまるで人をあざけるかのようで、木々が入り組みすぎていて、永遠に同じところをぐるぐる回っているような気分になる。

key: It was probably by luck that I stumbled upon this train again after having been lost in my expedition.
en: It was probably by luck that I stumbled upon this train again after having been lost in my expedition.
ja: 探索の途中で迷ったあと、この列車に偶然たどり着けたのは、幸運だったのだろう。

key: I'll continue searching for any sign of orient.
en: I'll continue searching for any sign of orient.
ja: 方角の手がかりを、引き続き探すことにする。

key: Thursday 7:18 PM: It's now been just about a full week since I was stranded in this forest.
en: Thursday 7:18 PM: It's now been just about a full week since I was stranded in this forest.
ja: 木曜日 午後7時18分:この森に取り残されてから、ちょうど一週間が経とうとしている。

key: Supplies in the train are diminishing quickly.
en: Supplies in the train are diminishing quickly.
ja: 列車内の物資が、急速に減ってきている。

key: I find myself rationing more and I desperately hope to discover a source of berries in the woods.
en: I find myself rationing more and I desperately hope to discover a source of berries in the woods.
ja: 配給をさらに切り詰めるようになり、森の中でこのみの供給源が見つかることを切実に願っている。

key: It seems the Pokémon I obtained as a surprise for my daughter will have to be relegated to a gift of apology instead.
en: It seems the Pokémon I obtained as a surprise for my daughter will have to be relegated to a gift of apology instead.
ja: 娘へのサプライズとして手に入れたポケモンは、どうやら代わりに謝罪の贈り物になってしまいそうだ。

key: Approx. projected delay: Unknown.
en: Approx. projected delay: Unknown.
ja: 予想遅延時間:不明。

key: Saturday 1:20 AM:
en: Saturday 1:20 AM:
ja: 土曜日 午前1時20分:

key: This nightmarish place knows no logic, and yet I think that by a stroke of luck, I may have found the way.
en: This nightmarish place knows no logic, and yet I think that by a stroke of luck, I may have found the way.
ja: この悪夢のような場所には論理などないが、幸運にも、道を見つけたかもしれない。

key: While searching deep in among the woods, I spotted an opening I did not recogize.
en: While searching deep in among the woods, I spotted an opening I did not recogize.
ja: 森の奥深くを探索している最中、見覚えのない開口部を見つけた。

key: As I followed it down a twisted path, I came to a cave.
en: As I followed it down a twisted path, I came to a cave.
ja: ねじれた小道をたどっていくと、洞窟に行き着いた。

key: The very cave through which the rail traveled!
en: The very cave through which the rail traveled!
ja: まさに、線路が通っていたはずの洞窟だ!

key: I recognized the stone, but strangely, I could see no rail.
en: I recognized the stone, but strangely, I could see no rail.
ja: 岩肌には見覚えがあったが、奇妙なことに、線路はどこにも見当たらなかった。

key: Tomorrow I will gather what supplies I have left and quit this place once and for all.
en: Tomorrow I will gather what supplies I have left and quit this place once and for all.
ja: 明日、残った物資をまとめて、この場所を今度こそ完全に離れることにする。

key: Sunday 11:20 PM:
en: Sunday 11:20 PM:
ja: 日曜日 午後11時20分:

key: As if to taunt me with a glimpse of hope, I have not been successful in my evacuation.
en: As if to taunt me with a glimpse of hope, I have not been successful in my evacuation.
ja: 希望の光を見せておいてあざけ笑うかのように、脱出には成功しなかった。

key: Though I left early this morning, and searched again through every hour of the day, I was unable to locate the railcave from last night.
en: Though I left early this morning, and searched again through every hour of the day, I was unable to locate the railcave from last night.
ja: 今朝早くに出発し、一日中探し続けたが、昨夜見つけた線路の洞窟を見つけることはできなかった。

key: At this point, and with as little food as is left in this car, I will likely scarcely be able to make it to Orre alive.
en: At this point, and with as little food as is left in this car, I will likely scarcely be able to make it to Orre alive.
ja: ここまで来ると、この車両に残った食料の少なさを考えれば、生きてオーレにたどり着けるかどうかも怪しい。

key: Wednesday 2:47 PM:
en: Wednesday 2:47 PM:
ja: 水曜日 午後2時47分:

key: To my amazement, I once again found the same cave last night.
en: To my amazement, I once again found the same cave last night.
ja: 驚くべきことに、昨夜また同じ洞窟を見つけた。

key: To my chagrin, I was unable to traverse it.
en: To my chagrin, I was unable to traverse it.
ja: 悔しいことに、そこを通り抜けることはできなかった。

key: Though the rails linger inside the cave, they lead nowhere.
en: Though the rails linger inside the cave, they lead nowhere.
ja: 線路は洞窟の中に残ってはいるが、どこにも通じていない。

key: What I knew once as a sensible and one-directional tunnel now twists endlessly.
en: What I knew once as a sensible and one-directional tunnel now twists endlessly.
ja: かつては筋の通った一方通行のトンネルだったはずが、今は際限なくねじれている。

key: As if my entire life had been tossed into a kaleidoscope, I was unable to navigate the cave, and in fact, when I did finally find an exit--
en: As if my entire life had been tossed into a kaleidoscope, I was unable to navigate the cave, and in fact, when I did finally find an exit--
ja: まるで人生そのものが万華鏡に放り込まれたかのようで、洞窟を進むことができなかった。実際、ようやく出口を見つけたと思ったら――

key: It turned out to be the very way in which I entered.
en: It turned out to be the very way in which I entered.
ja: それは、自分が入ってきたのとまったく同じ場所だった。

key: I've returned here for the night.
en: I've returned here for the night.
ja: 今夜はここに戻ってきた。

key: I will try again tomorrow.
en: I will try again tomorrow.
ja: 明日、また挑戦する。

key: Sunday 3:34 AM:
en: Sunday 3:34 AM:
ja: 日曜日 午前3時34分:

key: When even finding the entrance to a cave proves difficult, traversing it appears impossible.
en: When even finding the entrance to a cave proves difficult, traversing it appears impossible.
ja: 洞窟の入り口を見つけることさえ難しいとなれば、通り抜けるのは不可能に思える。

key: I have gone a precise way for these past few days, tracing my steps exactly.
en: I have gone a precise way for these past few days, tracing my steps exactly.
ja: ここ数日は、正確な道筋をたどり、自分の足跡を正確に追ってきた。

key: By now I have reliably found that although the path shifts, it is always through the southeast that I am able to stumble into it.
en: By now I have reliably found that although the path shifts, it is always through the southeast that I am able to stumble into it.
ja: 今では確実にわかったことがある。道は変化するが、そこへたどり着けるのはいつも南東方向からだ。

key: The inside is maddening alone, however. This will require further expedition.
en: The inside is maddening alone, however. This will require further expedition.
ja: しかし、内部だけでも気が狂いそうになる。さらなる探索が必要だろう。

key: Wednesday 7:44 PM:
en: Wednesday 7:44 PM:
ja: 水曜日 午後7時44分:

key: After exploring the cave and its nonsensical passages several times more,
en: After exploring the cave and its nonsensical passages several times more,
ja: あの洞窟と、その支離滅裂な通路を、さらに何度も探索した後、

key: I have reliably found a path to a certain cove within the Railcave, and I plan to relocate my remaining supplies there as I press forward.
en: I have reliably found a path to a certain cove within the Railcave, and I plan to relocate my remaining supplies there as I press forward.
ja: レールケイブ内のある入り江への道を、確実に見つけることができた。前進しながら、残りの物資をそこへ移すつもりだ。

key: I will move forward as swiftly as possible with what little food is left, and my daughter's Pokémon in tow.
en: I will move forward as swiftly as possible with what little food is left, and my daughter's Pokémon in tow.
ja: 残りわずかな食料と、娘のポケモンを連れて、できる限り速やかに前へ進むつもりだ。

key: For whoever may find this train, know the hardships I have faced.
en: For whoever may find this train, know the hardships I have faced.
ja: この列車を見つけた者へ、私が直面してきた苦難を知ってほしい。

key: Know, too, how you might escape these labyrinthine woods.
en: Know, too, how you might escape these labyrinthine woods.
ja: そして、この迷宮のような森から抜け出す方法も。

key: Should you find the Railcave, remember, the direction the rails move is no clue to traversing it.
en: Should you find the Railcave, remember, the direction the rails move is no clue to traversing it.
ja: レールケイブを見つけたなら、覚えておいてほしい。線路が動く方向は、通り抜ける手がかりにはならないということを。

key: But as it may be, while they do not point you in the right direction, that appears to be all the guidance you need.
en: But as it may be, while they do not point you in the right direction, that appears to be all the guidance you need.
ja: だが、正しい方向を示してはくれないとはいえ、それこそが必要な導きのすべてであるように思える。

key: Good luck, stranger.
en: Good luck, stranger.
ja: 幸運を祈る、見知らぬ者よ。

key: This is the captain, signing out.
en: This is the captain, signing out.
ja: 船長より、以上。

key: An Egg seems to have been abandoned here...
en: An Egg seems to have been abandoned here...
ja: ここに、タマゴが置き去りにされているようだ……

key: Take it?
en: Take it?
ja: 拾いますか?

key: \PN got the Egg!
en: \PN got the Egg!
ja: \PNはタマゴを手に入れた!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
